rationale: AEIS needed a production-readiness load test that verifies 10x expected peak, p99 latency, DB connection count, memory growth and worker dispatch latency instead of relying on a roadmap note. This change adds a LoadTestRunner and quality API endpoints that execute and persist the load test with Evidence Spine artifacts.

steps: Remove load test routes from sylion.api.quality_routes.
Remove sylion.quality.load_test and its export from sylion.quality.__init__.
Remove load test runner and quality load route tests.
Run runtime_perf, memory_footprint and worker lifecycle regression tests twice.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that AEIS can run a configurable 10x load profile, records p99, DB connection, memory and worker dispatch metrics, fails closed when thresholds are breached and exposes results through the quality API.
pre_conditions: SQLite runtime is available for in-process load events.
RuntimePerfTracker and MemoryFootprintTracker can record measurements.
EvidenceSpine can register inline JSON artifacts.
steps: Run compileall for load_test, quality __init__ and quality_routes.
Run unit tests for passing 10x profile, fail-closed p99 threshold and 10x multiplier validation.
Run API tests for run/list/get load test endpoints.
Run runtime_perf, memory_footprint and worker lifecycle regressions.
Run no-mock scan and git diff whitespace check.
Repeat the same verification scope as PASS2.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: The 10x load test returns pass only when p99, DB connection count, memory growth and worker dispatch latency are within thresholds, and every run has evidence.
